episodes.source_context: Stacks Project Chow Homology 42.12, 42.15.2 and 42.20: proper pushforward on cycles/Chow groups and f_*f^*=d for finite locally free degree-d maps.

relations: finite sheets have no canonical preferred sheet but admit a degree-weighted aggregate on the base
constraints: finite locally free cover of constant degree over the active open
proper pushforward is defined on the cycle
rational coefficients are allowed for degree normalization
failure_mechanisms: a single global section is unavailable because witness sheets can permute
invariants_to_preserve: codimension under finite relative dimension zero
desired_transition: replace single-section dependence by a base algebraic cycle obtained from finite-sheet aggregation
forbidden_losses: replace algebraic cycles by a weaker motivated or cohomological category

episodes.operation: Push the finite-cover cycle to the base by proper pushforward and, over Q, normalize by the cover degree when comparing with a pulled-back base class.
preconditions: the cover is finite locally free of positive constant degree d on the active open
the upstairs object is an algebraic cycle of the required codimension
proper pushforward is taken along the induced proper finite map to the base family
rational coefficients are available if normalization by 1/d is used
resulting_relations: replace single-section dependence by a base algebraic cycle obtained from finite-sheet aggregation
preserved_invariants: codimension under finite relative dimension zero
known_breakpoints: positive-dimensional generic fibres do not have a single finite degree without a separate multisection construction
integral coefficients do not permit unconditional division by d
wrong or sheet-dependent cohomology classes can average to the wrong class
